claims_checked.claim: Japanese National Railways was divided/privatized in 1987 into JR companies.
Tokyo has two subway operators: Tokyo Metro and Toei.
Through-running lets private suburban trains continue onto subway tracks.
claims_checked.note: Common in Tokyo/Osaka; not every line.

claims_checked.claim: IC cards merged the companies into one railway.
Hankyu-style private railways combined rails, housing, and department stores.
claims_checked.note: Well-documented business history; not every private railway followed the same mix.

caveats_about_absolutes: Note regional, generational, and situational variation
